wire.headline: Vexel Logistics to cut 4,800 UK jobs as revenue falls
sentences: Vexel Logistics has announced that it will cancel 4,800 jobs across its UK depots.
The company stated that these redundancies are effective from 14 June 2024.
CEO Marian Holt cited a 12% revenue decline since 2023 as the reason for the cuts.
The restructuring is expected to save 310m GBP in annual operating costs.
Employees will receive a severance package valued at 12.4p per share.
Shares dropped 5.2% in pre-market trading in London following the announcement.
The company's HQ confirmed that there will be no change to customer service levels.

PD.headline: Deeside Depot Faces Massive Staff Cuts as Local Officials Step In

sentences.text: Vexel Logistics has stated that 4,800 jobs across its UK depots will be cancelled.
A local newspaper has reported that 80% of staff at the Deeside site are facing redundancy.
The Deeside depot is set to lose 120 of its 150 permanent employees.
The reason for the cuts was cited by CEO Marian Holt as a 12% revenue decline since 2023.
A representative from Unite visited the Deeside site on 19 May 2024.
The local council is scheduled to host a town hall meeting on 22 May 2024.
